### Trusting God in the Dry Seasons
Author: Laura Bailey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-decermber-24-2019.html
Passage: Ezekiel 37:11
Points:
- Israel in exile felt abandoned, withered in faith, and completely stripped of hope.
- Believers often mirror the Israelites by questioning God's faithfulness during difficult spiritual dry spells.
- Distraction and conditional trust cause our souls to feel dry and distant from God.
- God remains faithful and committed to fulfilling His covenant promises of restoration.
- Spiritual renewal begins when believers repent and tune their hearts to hear God's Word.

### When a Dream Dies
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-february-1-2017.html
Passage: Ezekiel 37:4-5
Points:
- Circumstances that seem completely dead may only need to be awakened by God.
- Speaking life and promise into bleak situations can feel awkward and irrational to human eyes.
- Ezekiel demonstrated obedient faith by prophesying over dry bones rather than writing them off.
- God has absolute power to rebuild broken marriages, mend relationships, and revive dormant dreams.
- Believers are called to persist in faithful prayer instead of giving up on perceived lost causes.

### Resurrected and Reunified
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/resurrected-and-reunified
Passage: Ezekiel 37:13-14
Points:
- The valley of dry, unburied bones portrayed Israel as helpless and spiritually dead in Babylonian exile.
- Just as decomposed skeletons cannot revive on their own, dead sinners cannot generate spiritual life.
- God sovereignly brings dead people to life through the proclamation of His Word and His Spirit.
- The prophetic promise of resurrection finds its ultimate realization in the work of Jesus Christ.
- New covenant believers are united in Christ and share the promise of bodily resurrection and restored creation.

### Renewed Hope from Dead Circumstances
Author: Jared Kennedy
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/hope-dead-circumstances/
Passage: Ezekiel 37:1-14
Points:
- Dry bones possess no power of their own to assemble or generate life.
- The vision illustrates the miracle of regeneration, where God's Spirit imparts life to dead souls.
- For Israel in exile, God guaranteed a literal return and renewal in their own land.
- God speaks His life-giving Word into current painful circumstances that feel spiritually exhausted or broken.
- Believers can anchor their hope in God's final promise of bodily resurrection in the new creation.
